headline: subagent reasoning transcripts are deleted by the runtime while the session is still running; written evidence decays, it is not merely sometimes-absent

corrects_earlier_conclusion.earlier: absent transcripts were NEVER written, not truncated
corrects_earlier_conclusion.why_it_was_wrong: true of the attempts sampled then, and still true of 27 attempts, but incomplete: files that were written with a recorded size and digest have since disappeared
corrects_earlier_conclusion.how_found: an existence check over every manifest path before launching the stage-1 auditors

observations: one manifest entry (80 bytes, digest recorded) was gone from tasks/ hours after the manifest was built and had never been mirrored: permanently lost
two transcripts held in the durable mirror are already absent from tasks/ and were never in the manifest
a 714-byte file present during a mirror --dry-run was gone when the real run executed seconds later

permanently_lost.status: content no longer exists anywhere; only the digest survives

controls_installed: stage-1 slices resolve each transcript to the durable mirror first; live tasks/ is the fallback only
a transcript present in neither is dropped from the slice and REPORTED as lost, never silently omitted
the durable store is swept so a held transcript missing from the manifest is still assigned to a slice
the lost list and the held-not-in-manifest list are carried into every stage-1 packet, so the stage-2 final checker must state them as coverage facts in its verdict
remaining_risk: the mirror runs only when the orchestrator runs it; a transcript written and deleted between two mirror runs is lost leaving only its manifest digest. The window is narrowed, not closed. Closing it would need a mirror run immediately after every wave lands.

bearing_on_owner_directives.OW-6: 'everything written by a subagent even chain of thought' remains satisfiable only for the transcripts that still exist; the stage-2 checker states per-attempt coverage honestly
bearing_on_owner_directives.OW-6c: the end-of-campaign re-check of all chain of thought is bounded by what the durable store holds at that time. For books closed BEFORE the mirror existed, transcripts are already gone. This is a fact the owner needs when deciding the scope of that re-check.

authority: orchestrator finding; candidate-only, non-authorizing; no corpus row is affected
